title: An action in progress
description: A stable button moves through saving, success and error without changing its footprint.
useCase: Keep an asynchronous action understandable from the first click through its outcome.
interaction: Save changes, then try the error state
reducedMotion: Status labels crossfade without traveling or blurring, and the spinner remains still.
limitations: The demo uses a 1.2-second simulated save; connect useAsyncAction to your real action.
look: Warm light-grey page with one white rounded bordered button with a soft shadow, and a small checkbox caption below.
motion: Clicking spring-crossfades overlapping faces (opacity, 3 px rise, blur) from label to spinner to a green check or red alert at a fixed width, resetting after 1.4 s.
adapt: `useAsyncAction` owns the run-id state machine (`resetAfter` defaults to 1400); each face in `faces` overlaps in one grid cell and animates `opacity`, `y` and `filter` with the `CROSSFADE` spring. Pass your real save to `action` and relabel `faces`.
